prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1423; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact. Initial evaluation documented pain and swelling of the right knee, with positive findings on the examination supporting a soft tissue injury to the knee. Other tests, including ligament stability and neurovascular assessment, were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same body area is known to the treating team. Over the course of 23 visits, the treatment plan followed a typical progression of physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and anti-inflammatory medication. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and range of motion returned, and care was tapered accordingly. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue a home exercise program as needed.
